text:
eng-release-manager: Heads up — after the cert rotation in eu-west1 the staging canary shows a 5xx spike on /v1/generate. Rolling back or pin required, need quick decision.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] Canary deploy 5229801229 -> staging-eu-west1 at 10% traffic. Health checks: 503 rate +12% over baseline.

ops-oncall: Logs show TLS handshake errors: "tls: first record does not look like a TLS handshake" from the nginx-proxy sidecar. Most requests are failing during ssl handshake.

sre-lead: Looks like the rotated cert chain on the canary image is incompatible with our old cipher list. Two options: (A) pin to previous stable image, (B) quick patch to fallback to older cipher list. Pinning is faster.

andrea-dev: I built a minimal hotfix branch hotfix/staging-cert-fallback that sets TLS fallback behavior and backs out the new cert chain. Image: ghcr.io/redwood/inference:hotfix-cert-20260320. But that still requires canary verification.

eng-release-manager: Policy: skipping canary requires two approvers. We need an expedited pin consent to avoid customer-facing regressions in staging. @sre-lead and @ryan-pm please confirm.

ryan-pm: +1 to pin to the last known-good image for staging only. Avoids blast radius. We'll track follow-up fix in the next sprint.

sre-lead: I approve. I'll take ownership of the staged pin and monitoring. Ops, please run the rollback/pin commands when ready.

ops-oncall: Approving now. Executing pin command.

andrea-dev: Command I recommend:```
kubectl -n staging set image deployment/inference inference=ghcr.io/redwood/inference:20260310-stable
kubectl rollout status deployment/inference -n staging --watch
```

deploy-bot: [deploybot] User eng-release-manager requested image update to ghcr.io/redwood/inference:20260310-stable in namespace staging. Starting rollout.

sre-lead: Rollout in progress — watching health metrics. Prometheus: 5xx ratio trending down. Latency stable.

ops-oncall: Rollout complete. Staging 5xx and TLS handshake errors returned to baseline. Returning traffic to normal levels.

ryan-pm: I'll add a short release note: "Staging emergency pin to 20260310 due to cert rotation causing TLS handshake failures. Hotfix image and proper cert-chain fix scheduled in next sprint."

eng-release-manager: :thumbsup: Good catch everyone. Filing follow-up RFC for cert rotation choreography and adding a pre-rotation smoke test to the TLS runbook: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/tls-rotation|TLS rotation runbook>. Closing this thread.

sre-lead: Closing monitoring loop. Will post postmortem if anything reproduces.

ops-oncall: Incident closed. :white_check_mark:
